verdict.rationale: Brex documents a public developer API with multiple resource areas (Accounting, Budgets, Webhooks, Team), a quickstart guide, and an llms.txt discoverable at developer.brex.com confirming it's a documented API surface, plus an official MCP server for agentic access. Missing for 10: a publicly reachable OpenAPI/swagger spec (candidate paths 404) and independent hands-on developer corroboration of API usage.
